title: SimpleCrops
description: A lightweight Paper farming plugin that prevents crop trampling and lets players right-click mature crops with a hoe to harvest and auto-replant.
body:
# 🚀 SimpleCrops > Protect your fields and harvest with ease. **SimpleCrops** is a lightweight, performance-focused Paper plugin that improves the vanilla farming experience. It protects your hard work by preventing crop destruction from trampling and introduces a faster, more satisfying harvesting mechanic using hoes. Every feature is fully optimized, **ensuring zero impact on your server's performance.** --- ## ✨ Features ### 🌾 Enhanced Farming & Protection - **Farmland Protection:** Stop players and mobs from trampling farmland and turning it back to dirt. - **Right-Click Harvest:** Right-click mature crops with a hoe to instantly harvest them. - **Auto-Replant:** The plugin automatically replants a seed from the drops, letting you collect the rest of the yield with zero hassle. - **Supported Crops:** Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroots, and Nether Warts. --- ## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions > 💡 **Tip:** You can use either `/simplecrops` or the shorter alias `/sc` for all commands. * 💻 `/sc help` — Shows grouped help and usage examples. * 📊 `/sc status` — Shows the current crop protection and harvest settings. * 🌱 `/sc cropDestruction ` — Enables or disables crop destruction from farmland trampling. * 🌾 `/sc hoeHarvest ` — Enables or disables right-click harvesting and automatic replanting with hoes. * ⚙️ `/sc reload` — Reloads the plugin configuration file (`config.yml`). - Admin commands require: `simplecrops.admin` (Granted to OP by default) - Player commands require: `simplecrops.command` (Granted to OP by default) --- ## ⚙️ Default Configuration
📄 Click to view the default config.yml ```yaml # SimpleCrops Configuration File version: 1.0 farming: crop-destruction-enabled: false hoe-harvest-enabled: true ```
--- ## 📦 Installation 1. Download the latest `.jar` file from the **Versions** tab. 2. Drop it into your Paper server's `plugins` folder. 3. Restart your server. 4. Configure settings in-game via command or inside `plugins/SimpleCrops/config.yml`. --- ## 💜 Support & Suggest Features If SimpleCrops helped improve your server, consider supporting the development! - **💰 Support & Pitch an Idea:** You can make a donation via [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=TANK86W7A2RBS). Have a feature idea? Leave a suggestion in your donation note! - **💬 Discord Community:** Official Discord server prepared for support and discussions. Join: [Discord Club](https://discord.gg/gBNzfRTYrF)!
